title: Yowana Wamala: 100-Mile Weeks With a Full-Time Job
excerpt: Yowana Wamala runs 100-mile weeks while owning a business and working full time, he told Believe in the Run. How to fit more running into a busy week.
body:
On episode 426 of the Believe in the Run podcast, published in January 2026, Yowana Wamala, founder and CEO of Supwell, talked about running 100-mile weeks while owning a business and working full time.

Most runners will never need 100 miles a week, but the problem is the same at any volume: training has to fit around work, family and sleep. Consistency over months matters more than any single big week.

If you want to increase your mileage around work, start by looking at your week for unused time instead of cutting sleep. Early mornings, lunchtime runs and running all or part of your commute add up faster than most runners expect.

Source: Believe in the Run, episode 426
keyTakeaway: Find training time in unused parts of your week, not by cutting sleep.
